About the job
Medjerda Rail Services maintains a fleet of 60 locomotives for passenger and freight lines.

Your mission
- Build failure statistics from our CMMS (SAP PM) and compute MTBF and availability per subsystem.
- Run an FMEA on the bogie and traction systems with the maintenance team.

Profile
- Final-year engineering student in industrial or reliability & maintenance engineering.
- Weibull analysis and basic statistics.
- Python or Excel for data analysis.
- Fluent French and good English.

Nice to have
- Experience with Power BI dashboards.
